home.storyTitle: About the National Mission Commission of Nepal
home.storyBody: NMCN is a Nepalese indigenous, non-profit social organisation. We train and equip young people and community leaders to serve their communities, providing education and scholarships to marginalised people groups across Nepal.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.intro: A Nepalese indigenous, non-profit social organisation
whoWeAre.heading: We Train and Equip Young People and Community Leaders to Serve their Community
whoWeAre.aboutBody: National Mission Commission of Nepal (NMCN) is a national indigenous, non-profit social organisation, established in 2001 and registered with the Nepali Government in 2011. We are committed to transforming communities by empowering individuals to improve their lives and build sustainable futures.
whoWeAre.missionBody: To train and empower individuals and communities to reach out to the marginalised people groups in Nepal.
whoWeAre.visionBody: Transforming our communities, empowering them to improve their lives and build sustainable communities.
whoWeAre.agmBody: Our members, staff and volunteers gathered for the 2025 Annual General Meeting to reflect on the year's work, celebrate impact and plan for the future.
whoWeAre.teamBody: A dedicated team of staff and volunteers work across our education centres and community programmes.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.intro: We aim to provide education and scholarships to the marginalised people groups in Nepal.
whatWeDo.projectsBody: We run education centres that provide regular weekday classes and extracurricular activities, helping children and families learn new skills and improve their lives.
whatWeDo.approachBody: NMCN facilitates and organises training to educate and equip individuals and communities through a holistic, community-centred approach.
